notes.title: v0.03.07 release
notes.content:
Hello all! We are happy to release v0.03.07 of XANDO. The vast majority of our work over this past month has been improving the XANDO AI and adding difficulty levels to it. So please check that out again and let us know what you think about the new difficulty levels! See below for a list of all of the updates. 

XANDO AI
Various bug fixes and improvement to overall intelligence
Human players can no longer select the what space will be shielded/trapped for the AI
Human players can no longer select “Undo” for the AI
Added a difficulty select when facing the AI

Art
Various tweaks and improvements to UI placement and size

Music
Added in defeat music for when playing online or against an AI
When matches are getting closer to ending, the main theme now transitions to a “heat-up” track
